name: Sword Adept
effectText: When you attack with a weapon that has the Sword tag, the bonus momentum cost to use Swift Task to attack again is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 0.

name: Blade Master 1
effectText: If you miss an attack with a weapon with the Sword tag and take the Swift Task to attack again the same turn, you may add a bonus die to your pool on the second attack.

name: Blade Master 2
effectText: When you use Swift Task to make an attack with the Sword tag, lower the Difficulty on that attack's roll by -1.
